settings.heading: Inside the SUF Library
settings.body:
Every SUF-CPT includes access to the SUF Library — your complete video curriculum and live calls, recorded and on demand. Inside you’ll find the full Level 1 SUF-CPT course, the live class schedule, a programming and exercise library, and replays of past calls. Study on your schedule, then show up live when you want real trainers answering your real questions. Add a Level 2 certification later and the entire library opens up — every course and every call, including all the Soft Tissue and Nutrition content.

Your certification includes 3 months of access. The Seminar Bundle extends it to 6. The Qualified Trainer Package extends it to lifetime.

settings.heading: A Live Exam, In Front of Real Coaches
settings.body: Textbook certifications end with a multiple-choice test. The SUF-CPT ends with you, live, in front of Show Up Fitness coaches — naming 17 muscles of the shoulder, 20 muscles of the lower body, identifying the 8 core movement patterns, and designing a real program on the spot in 15 minutes. When you pass, it’s because you can actually do the job. That’s why elite gyms trust the credential.

settings.question: Do I need any experience or prerequisites?
settings.answer: No. The SUF-CPT starts at square one and builds from there. Most people come in either brand new to training or certified elsewhere and looking for the practical skills their textbook program skipped.

settings.question: How long does it take?
settings.answer: At your own pace. Most people take two to three months alongside a job, working through the SUF Library and joining the live calls, then schedule the exam when they feel ready.

settings.question: Is the SUF-CPT accredited?
settings.answer: Show Up Fitness is working through the NCCA accreditation process. The credential is already recognised where it matters most — Life Time, Equinox, and other elite gyms hire SUF-CPTs directly.

settings.question: What happens if I do not pass the exam?
settings.answer: You retake it. The exam is a demonstration, not a gate — coaches tell you exactly what to work on, you go back to the material, and you come back when you are ready.

settings.question: Do you offer payment plans?
settings.answer: Yes — you can pay over time with Affirm at checkout. A quick soft credit check (no impact to your score) shows the plans you qualify for.
